description: "Every update to the China Semiconductor Tracker's data, newest first — one entry per change, linked to its git diff."

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
```

This page is built automatically from the project's version history: each entry is one change to the data files (facilities, design firms, equipment/materials firms, or Big Fund rounds). Click a change to see exactly which fields were edited on GitHub.

```{r changes, echo=FALSE, results='asis', warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# Read the git log for commits that touched data/*.yml.
# %H = full hash, %ad = date, %s = subject line; fields separated by tabs.
log_lines <- tryCatch(
  system2("git", c("log", "--date=short", "--format=%H%x09%ad%x09%s", "--",
                   "data/facilities.yml", "data/design.yml", "data/materials.yml", "data/funding.yml"),
          stdout = TRUE, stderr = FALSE),
  error = function(e) character(0)
)

if (length(log_lines) == 0) {
  cat("*Change history is not available in this build.*\n")
} else {
  parts <- strsplit(log_lines, "\t", fixed = TRUE)
  changes <- tibble(
    hash    = vapply(parts, `[`, character(1), 1),
    date    = as.Date(vapply(parts, `[`, character(1), 2)),
    subject = vapply(parts, `[`, character(1), 3)
  ) %>%
    # Strip the conventional-commit prefix ("data: ", "fix: ") for readers
    mutate(subject = sub("^[a-z]+(\\([^)]*\\))?:\\s*", "", subject))

  repo <- "https://github.com/pranaykotas/china-semiconductor-tracker/commit/"

  # Group by month, newest first
  changes$month <- format(changes$date, "%B %Y")
  for (m in unique(changes$month)) {
    cat("\n## ", m, "\n\n", sep = "")
    rows <- changes[changes$month == m, ]
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(rows))) {
      # Escape square brackets so a subject cannot break the Markdown link
      subj <- gsub("([][])", "\\\\\\1", rows$subject[i])
      cat(sprintf("- **%s** — [%s](%s%s)\n", format(rows$date[i], "%d %b"), subj, repo, rows$hash[i]))
    }
  }
}
```
